versions.subject: Fix more FP in testing
versions.detection:
selection:
    Initiated: 'true'
    Image|contains: python
filter_conda:
    # Related to anaconda updates. Command example: "conda update conda"
    # This filter will only work with aurora agent enriched data as Sysmon EID 3 doesn't contain CommandLine nor ParentImage
    ParentImage: C:\ProgramData\Anaconda3\Scripts\conda.exe
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'C:\ProgramData\Anaconda3\Scripts\conda-script.py'
        - 'update'
filter_conda_jupyter_notebook:
    # Related to anaconda opening an instance of Jupyter Notebook
    # This filter will only work with aurora agent enriched data as Sysmon EID 3 doesn't contain CommandLine nor ParentImage
    ParentImage: C:\ProgramData\Anaconda3\python.exe
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'C:\ProgramData\Anaconda3\Scripts\jupyter-notebook-script.py'
filter_local_communication:
    # This coumd be caused when launching an instance of Jupyter Notebook locally for example but can also be caused by other instances of python openning sockets locally etc. So comment this out if you want to monitor for those instances
    DestinationIp: 127.0.0.1
    SourceIp: 127.0.0.1
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: Initiated="true" Image="*python*" NOT ((ParentImage="C:\\ProgramData\\Anaconda3\\Scripts\\conda.exe" CommandLine="*C:\\ProgramData\\Anaconda3\\Scripts\\conda-script.py*" CommandLine="*update*") OR (ParentImage="C:\\ProgramData\\Anaconda3\\python.exe" CommandLine="*C:\\ProgramData\\Anaconda3\\Scripts\\jupyter-notebook-script.py*") OR (DestinationIp="127.0.0.1" SourceIp="127.0.0.1"))
